title: Support for (only) indexing nested fields in an array of objects using dot notation.
body:
## Description

I am currently trying to set up typesense using the firebase extension.  We're monitoring one collection and want to index certain fields, some of which are nested in an array of objects. I specify `field1` in the `Firestore Collection Fields` input, and in my schema I try to reference `field1.nested1.nested2`.  Again, this value has this shape: 
`field1: {
  nested1: [ ... { nested2: <value> } ]
}`.  
When items are saved to firebase, I see 
`Error: Request failed with HTTP code 404 | Server said: Field field1.nested1.nested2 not found.`
in the firebase logs

Related thread about this issue: https://github.com/typesense/typesense/issues/227#issuecomment-1219117094
Related slack thread: https://<redacted-host>/archives/C01P749N8HL/p1683566890758039

## Steps to reproduce

- Setup a firebase collection with some values.  One of these values should be an array of objects, each object containing a string value.
- Create a new typesense collection, and in the schema, try to reference this nested string value directly using dot notation (e.g. `fields: { "name": "field1.nested1.nested2", "type": string[] }`)` 
- Install the typesense extension onto your firebase collection.  Put `field1` in the `Firestore Collection Fields` input
- Once installed, add some data to this firebase collection.  Data is expected to index into typesense.
- Data is not indexed, see error in firebase logs instead: `Error: Request failed with HTTP code 404 | Server said: Field field1.nested1.nested2 not found.`


## Expected Behavior

The data should be indexed to typesense, and I should be able to target the nested field in my search query.

## Actual Behavior

No data is indexed to typesense, and firebase logs produce the following error: 
`Error: Request failed with HTTP code 404 | Server said: Field field1.nested1.nested2 not found.
    at ApiCall.customErrorForResponse (/workspace/node_modules/typesense/lib/Typesense/ApiCall.js:226:21)
    at ApiCall.performRequest (/workspace/node_modules/typesense/lib/Typesense/ApiCall.js:118:48)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)`

## Metadata

**Typesense Version**:
Typesense v0.24.1

**OS**:
macOS Ventura 13.3.1

comments.body:
@reporter `v0.4.x` and earlier versions of the Firebase extension pre-flattened fields before sending the data over to Typesense in a way that did not work well with nested fields in v0.24 of Typesense Server.

So could you update your Firebase extension to v1.x, which will then show you a new option in the configuration screen called "Flatten nested fields". Could you set that to "No" and then run a backfill into your Typesense collection?
